tests.validationMethod: Cross-validate with CSV: pandas.read_csv('Fact_Sales.csv')['Sales Amount LC'].sum()
tests.passThreshold: Difference < 0.01 (rounding tolerance)

tests.expectedBehavior: Returns numeric value matching SUM(Fact_Budget.csv['Budget Amount LC'])
tests.validationMethod: Cross-validate with CSV: pandas.read_csv('Fact_Budget.csv')['Budget Amount LC'].sum()

tests.description: Verify # Transactions = COUNT of Fact_Sales rows
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE { ("Measure", "# Transactions", "Value", [# Transactions]) }

testSuites.suiteName: Time Intelligence - FYTD with Dynamic Parameters
testSuites.description: Validate fiscal year-to-date calculations with dynamic fiscal year start parameter

tests.description: Verify FYTD calculation with Fiscal Year Start = January (parameter = '1')
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Date[FiscalMonth], "Sales", [Sales Amount], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD]), [Sales FYTD], DESC)
tests.expectedBehavior: FYTD for March 2024 = SUM(Jan + Feb + Mar 2024 sales). Each month shows cumulative YTD starting from January.
tests.validationMethod: Verify cumulative pattern: FYTD(Month N) >= FYTD(Month N-1). FYTD resets at January 1st.
tests.passThreshold: Cumulative logic correct. FYTD increases or stays equal month-over-month within fiscal year.

tests.description: Verify FYTD calculation with Fiscal Year Start = July (parameter = '7')
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Date[FiscalMonth], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD]), [Sales FYTD], DESC)
tests.expectedBehavior: Fiscal Year 2025 starts Jul 2024. FYTD for Oct 2024 = SUM(Jul + Aug + Sep + Oct 2024). FYTD resets at July 1st, NOT January 1st.
tests.validationMethod: Verify fiscal year boundary: FYTD(Jul 2024) < FYTD(Aug 2024) < ... < FYTD(Jun 2025). Then resets at Jul 2025.
tests.passThreshold: Fiscal year boundaries correct. Parameter change recalculates fiscal year start.

tests.description: Verify Budget FYTD uses same fiscal year logic as Sales FYTD
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Date[FiscalMonth], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "Budget FYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD])
tests.expectedBehavior: Budget FYTD accumulates in same pattern as Sales FYTD. Both use same fiscal year boundaries.
tests.validationMethod: Verify both measures show cumulative pattern with same fiscal year start
tests.passThreshold: Cumulative patterns match (both reset at same fiscal year start)

tests.description: Verify Adjusted Profit FYTD uses same fiscal year logic
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Date[FiscalMonth], "Profit FYTD", [Adjusted Profit FYTD], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD])
tests.expectedBehavior: Profit FYTD accumulates in same pattern as Sales FYTD
tests.validationMethod: Verify cumulative pattern matches Sales FYTD fiscal year boundaries
tests.passThreshold: Fiscal year logic consistent across all FYTD measures

testSuites.description: Validate derived measures including budget variance, profit percentages, and conditional logic

tests.description: Verify Sales vs Budget = Sales Amount FYTD - Budget Amount FYTD
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Area[AreaName], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "Budget FYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "Variance", [Sales vs Budget])
tests.expectedBehavior: Variance = Sales FYTD - Budget FYTD for each area. Can be positive (above budget) or negative (below budget).
tests.validationMethod: Manual calculation: For each area, verify Variance = Sales - Budget
tests.passThreshold: Formula correct for all areas. Variance matches subtraction of displayed values.

tests.description: Verify Sales vs Budget % = (Sales FYTD - Budget FYTD) / Budget FYTD
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Area[AreaName], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "Budget FYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "Variance %", [Sales vs Budget %])
tests.expectedBehavior: Variance % = (Sales - Budget) / Budget. Returns decimal (e.g., 0.10 for 10% above budget).
tests.validationMethod: Manual calculation: Verify Variance % = (Sales - Budget) / Budget for each area
tests.passThreshold: Formula uses DIVIDE function. Returns BLANK if Budget = 0.

tests.description: Verify Budget Status returns 'Above Target' / 'Close to Target' / 'Below Target' based on Sales/Budget ratio
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Area[AreaName], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "Budget FYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "Status", [Budget Status])
tests.expectedBehavior: Status logic: IF Sales/Budget >= 1.0 THEN 'Above Target', IF >= 0.9 THEN 'Close to Target', ELSE 'Below Target' (verify exact thresholds in measure formula)
tests.validationMethod: Verify conditional logic: Calculate Sales/Budget ratio, check status matches threshold rules
tests.passThreshold: Status text correct for all areas. Thresholds consistent with specification.

tests.description: Verify Adjusted Profit % = Adjusted Profit / Sales Amount
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Area[AreaName], "Sales", [Sales Amount], "Profit", [Adjusted Profit], "Profit %", [Adjusted Profit %])
tests.expectedBehavior: Profit % = Profit / Sales. Returns decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15% profitability).
tests.validationMethod: Manual calculation: Verify Profit % = Profit / Sales for each area
tests.passThreshold: Formula uses DIVIDE. Returns BLANK if Sales = 0.

tests.description: Verify Average Monthly Sales = Sales Amount FYTD / Count of distinct fiscal months in FYTD period
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE { ("Measure", "Average Monthly Sales", "Value", [Average Monthly Sales], "FYTD Sales", [Sales Amount FYTD]) }
tests.expectedBehavior: Average = FYTD Sales / Month Count. For Q1 2024 with FY=Jan: Average = (Jan+Feb+Mar Sales) / 3
tests.validationMethod: Verify Average = FYTD Sales / number of distinct FiscalMonth values in FYTD period
tests.passThreshold: Formula correct. Average adjusts with fiscal year parameter changes.

testSuites.description: Validate edge case handling including zero division, BLANK values, and empty filters

tests.description: Verify Adjusted Profit % returns BLANK (not error) when Sales Amount = 0
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE FILTER(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Customer[CustomerName], "Sales", [Sales Amount], "Profit %", [Adjusted Profit %]), [Sales] = 0)
tests.expectedBehavior: Profit % column shows BLANK for customers with zero sales. NO #DIV/0! error displayed.
tests.validationMethod: Verify measure uses DIVIDE([Adjusted Profit], [Sales Amount], BLANK())
tests.passThreshold: No errors. BLANK values rendered correctly in results.

tests.testName: Zero Division Handling - Sales vs Budget %
tests.description: Verify Sales vs Budget % returns BLANK when Budget Amount FYTD = 0
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE FILTER(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Area[AreaName], "Budget FYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "Variance %", [Sales vs Budget %]), [Budget FYTD] = 0 || ISBLANK([Budget FYTD]))
tests.expectedBehavior: Variance % shows BLANK for areas/periods with no budget data
tests.validationMethod: Verify DIVIDE function 3rd parameter = BLANK()
tests.passThreshold: No errors. Graceful handling of missing budget data.

tests.description: Verify FYTD measures behave correctly when date filter is cleared (grand total scenario)
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE { ("Context", "All Dates", "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "Sales Total", [Sales Amount]) }
tests.expectedBehavior: When no date filter applied, FYTD should calculate based on MAX date in entire dataset
tests.validationMethod: Verify FYTD uses MAX(Dim_Date[Date]) to determine current date when filter context empty
tests.passThreshold: FYTD returns a value (not BLANK). Uses latest date in dataset as 'current date'.

testSuites.description: Validate dimensional filtering propagates correctly through relationships

tests.description: Verify filtering by Area correctly filters sales and budget measures
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Area[AreaName], "Sales", [Sales Amount], "Budget", [Budget Amount])
tests.expectedBehavior: Each area shows aggregated sales and budget. Totals by area sum to grand total.
tests.validationMethod: Verify Area → Customer relationship filters Fact_Sales correctly
tests.passThreshold: All areas displayed. No missing or duplicated values.

tests.description: Verify drill-down from Area → Country → Customer works correctly
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE TOPN(20, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Area[AreaName], Dim_Country[CountryName], Dim_Customer[CustomerName], "Sales", [Sales Amount]))
tests.expectedBehavior: Sales values aggregate correctly at each hierarchy level. Country totals = sum of customers in that country.
tests.validationMethod: Verify relationship chain: Fact_Sales → Dim_Customer → Dim_Country → Dim_Area
tests.passThreshold: Hierarchy navigation works. Totals aggregate correctly at each level.

tests.description: Verify filtering by Industry correctly filters sales
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Industry[IndustryName], "Sales", [Sales Amount], "# Customers", [# Customers])
tests.expectedBehavior: Each industry shows sales and unique customer count
tests.validationMethod: Verify Industry → Customer relationship filters correctly
tests.passThreshold: All industries displayed with correct sales attribution

testSuites.description: Validate query response times meet acceptable performance thresholds

tests.description: Verify single measure query executes quickly
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE { ("KPI", "Sales Amount FYTD", "Value", [Sales Amount FYTD]) }
tests.expectedBehavior: Query executes in < 1 second
tests.validationMethod: Measure query execution time
tests.passThreshold: Execution time < 1.0 sec (✅), 1-3 sec (⚠️ warning), >3 sec (❌ fail)

tests.description: Verify table with 5 measures and ~100 rows executes acceptably
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE TOPN(100, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Customer[CustomerName], "Sales", [Sales Amount], "Budget", [Budget Amount], "Profit", [Adjusted Profit], "Profit %", [Adjusted Profit %], "YOY %", [Sales YOY %]))
tests.expectedBehavior: Query executes in < 2 seconds
tests.validationMethod: Measure query execution time
tests.passThreshold: Execution time < 2.0 sec (✅), 2-5 sec (⚠️ warning), >5 sec (❌ fail)

tests.description: Verify FYTD calculation with FILTER over full date table performs acceptably
tests.daxQuery: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(Dim_Date[FiscalMonth], "Sales FYTD", [Sales Amount FYTD], "Budget FYTD", [Budget Amount FYTD], "Profit FYTD", [Adjusted Profit FYTD])
tests.expectedBehavior: Query executes in < 3 seconds despite FILTER(ALL(Dim_Date[Date])) logic
tests.validationMethod: Measure query execution time with fiscal year parameter
tests.passThreshold: Execution time < 3.0 sec (✅), 3-5 sec (⚠️ warning), >5 sec (❌ fail - optimization needed)

metadata.recommendedRetestFrequency: After any DAX measure modification, before production deployment
notes: Tests require Power BI Desktop to be open with model loaded
Parameter changes (Fiscal Year Start Month) should be tested with at least 3 scenarios: 1 (Jan), 7 (Jul), 10 (Oct)
Performance tests may vary based on hardware and data volume
CSV cross-validation requires source CSV files in SalesOverviewFYTD/data/ folder
